messages:
sam: Heads-up — ChroniclePay reporting repeated 429s in prod (eu-west) starting ~15:31 UTC. They say RPM/TPM limits hit, nothing in their deploy timeline. Can we triage?
ops-bot: Alert: ratecap triggered on /v1/generate tenant=chroniclepay region=eu-west headers: X-RateLimit-Remaining=0 Retry-After=60
erin: Copy. Is this a sudden spike or gradual ramp? Any recent config/deploys?
sam: Customer says sudden. They're running a pool of workers multiplexing HTTP/2 streams. Quick log snippet they sent:
```
2025-11-01T15:31:12Z request_id=abc123 tenant=chroniclepay status=429 route=/v1/generate remaining=0 retry_after=60
2025-11-01T15:31:13Z request_id=abc124 tenant=chroniclepay status=429 remaining=0
2025-11-01T15:31:14Z request_id=abc125 tenant=chroniclepay status=200 request_time_ms=120
```
katie: Thanks. Two immediate checks: 1) Are they hitting per-tenant RPM or an enforcement on a per-minute rolling window? 2) Are they sending bursts aligned to minute boundaries (minute fold)? Ask them for request timestamps and X-Client-Request-Id for a sample of failures.
sam: Their header dump shows: X-RateLimit-Limit=600 (RPM), X-RateLimit-Remaining=0, concurrent_http2_streams~120. They also show short retry loops on the client with no jitter.
devin: Easy repro path: replay a 10x compressed window to see minute-folding. Example: `redwood-replay --tenant chroniclepay --from=2025-11-01T15:25:00Z --to=2025-11-01T15:35:00Z --speed=10x --preserve-ids`
support: Suggested mitigations for customer: reduce concurrent streams (<=50), add exponential backoff + jitter, spread requests across second boundaries (avoid minute alignment), and consider client-side rate limiter (token bucket). We can also apply a temporary quota bump while they remediate.
erin: I'll approve a short-lived quota bump (+20% for 60m) if we confirm it's not a bug on our side. @sam, can you get 3 full traces (including request IDs) and the timestamps of their retry attempts?
sam: On it — asked them to 1) run the replay command with our tool and attach results, 2) reduce concurrency and retry with jitter, 3) send trace IDs for 3 failing requests. Will update here. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident created INC-2025-1777 assigned to erin for temporary quota change. :white_check_mark:
erin: After we have traces and replay, we'll check server-side logs for prefix cache hits and batching anomalies. If nothing server-side, we'll keep the quota bump for the window and schedule a postmortem with the customer to adjust client behavior.
sam: Customer confirmed they'll run replay and lower parallelism, will report back in ~20m. Thanks team.
